items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Basie ended up with Benny Goodman and John Hammond behind him... when they had the spook breakfasts, and Benny Goodman and those guys would come in... I remember when Goodman and Hammond and them heard of it

ctx.x: Basie ended up with Benny Goodman and John Hammond behind him--
Well, that's the point, isn't it?
